status: PROVISIONAL - definitions pending clinician/professor approval (see docs/STATUS.md, 'Decisions still pending'). Results computed with these rules are exploratory.
reference_source: COVID-19-CT-Seg expert lung and infection masks (data/raw/covid_ct). The infection annotation is not guaranteed exhaustive; disagreement is a review signal, not a confirmed model error.

opacity_presence.note: present if expert infection volume inside the lungs >= this value, else absent

laterality.note: same threshold as configs/review_flag_rules_v1.json: bilateral if the smaller side holds >= 5% of infection volume, else the larger side

craniocaudal.zones: lung superior-inferior extent (world z, RAS, both lungs together) split into equal thirds: upper, middle, lower
craniocaudal.note: <zone>_predominant if one zone holds >= 50% of infection volume, else no_predominance

axial.note: depth = Euclidean distance (mm) to the edge of the same lung, divided by that lung's maximum depth. Peripheral zone = depth fraction <= 1/3. Known limitation: the lung edge includes the mediastinal surface, so disease next to the mediastinum counts as peripheral.

ct_severity_score.note: per-lobe score 0-5 from percent of lobe involved (0 = none, 1 <5%, 2 5-25%, 3 25-50%, 4 50-75%, 5 >75%); total 0-25. Lobes are TotalSegmentator PREDICTIONS, so this is a near-reference. Not yet scored against model output (current prompt schema has no severity field).
